name: Marvel Super Heroes Character Editor
notes: v1.5.85: Added Build Mode dropdown at the left end of the creation bar with rich unique-aspect descriptions for all 6 creation modes (TSR & CMF Standard, Modeled, and CP Buy). Set Tier and Roll Tables buttons appear dynamically based on mode selection (Set Tier for Point-Buy, Roll Tables for Random Roll). Added automatic build conversion when changing modes where feasible, and pre-switch save warnings when conversion is not feasible.
